scope.description: Necessary local-support eligibility for ReadOnlySafe singleton responses after applied self-removal, with optional immediate step-down disabled and zero post-request peer communication.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers, unique new read context, serialized RawNode methods and valid applied membership history.
No quorum acknowledgment or other network message reaches the responder after the request.
excluded: No client read completion or stale returned application value is claimed; the documented application-wait condition remains outside the endpoint.
No liveness obligation to answer a read; no response is permitted.
No claim about lease reads, general dynamic quorum histories or arbitrary reuse of contexts.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes or direct state mutation. Partition drops every peer message after completed self-removal.
ReadStates are observed only for the unique request context; final result is always emitted after drain, including no-response control.
The post-request delivered-message counter is measured at the actual Step boundary.

plan_uncertainties: No completed stale client read is observed; caller application wait remains outside the checked component.
This checks necessary local support in a singleton configuration, not sufficiency of arbitrary read-index histories.
